transcript.answer: Otto never ran on Cloud Run in europe-north1 because the reason for choosing that region went away. Issue #27 picked `europe-north1` so the service would sit in the same region as the Vertex model, which was meant to answer the NIS-2 data-residency condition. Measurements on 2026-10-16 showed that `europe-north1` serves only the Gemini 2.5 family, and Google retires that family on 2026-10-20. The newer Gemini models answer only on Vertex AI's `eu` multi-region. No Gemini model newer than 2.5 answered in `europe-west1` or `europe-north1`. The other option, the model's `global` endpoint, was rejected because it gives up EU residency. ADR-003 also says the plan depended on terraform roots that the repository never built. The Cloud Run services and the planned `docs/adr/ADR-001-hosting-platform.md` were never built. Otto instead deploys with Helm to the shared GKE Autopilot cluster `n8n-cluster` in `europe-west1`, with the model on the Vertex `eu` multi-region. ADR-003 (#414) records this and its residency table. Issues #27, #162 and #168 were closed as superseded, and the Cloud Run requirements in the deployment spec were marked superseded.
